text: 有些人一直站在自己角度考虑问题。
en: Some people always consider matters from their own perspective.

text: 废除死刑的人他不会想到有一天他的家人被无辜残害，认为嫖娼合法化的人他不会想到他有一天，他的朋友有一天嫖娼嫖到自己的老婆和女儿。
en: Those who call for abolishing the death penalty do not stop to think that one day their own family might be innocently murdered; those who believe prostitution should be legalised do not stop to think that one day, he himself, or his friend, might go to a brothel and end up with his own wife and daughter.

text: 凡是提出卖淫合法化的人和支持卖淫合法化的人。
en: Anyone who proposes legalising prostitution and anyone who supports legalising prostitution.

text: 你们有没有想过一个问题？
en: Have you ever thought about a question?

text: 如果你老婆，姐妹，甚至是母亲。
en: If it were your wife, your sister, or even your mother.

text: 有被拐骗去从事这个活动的，而你进入这种场所点的姑娘刚好就是你的这个亲人。
en: who had been abducted and forced into this trade, and the girl you picked when you entered such an establishment happened to be this very relative of yours.

text: 你是什么心情？
en: How would you feel?

text: 不要觉得这是危言耸听。
en: Do not think this is mere alarmist scaremongering.

text: 国外卖淫合法的国家真的出现过这种情况。
en: Such situations have genuinely occurred in foreign countries where prostitution is legal.

text: 有人说有钱人可以长期包月，所以卖淫应该合法
en: Some say that because the wealthy can keep a long-term mistress, prostitution should be legal.

text: 那按这种思路来看卖器官是不是也应该合法？
en: Then by that logic, shouldn't selling organs also be legal?

text: 到最后结局就是富哥权力越来越大，这种不经过上面那个头思考的逻辑只能是瓢虫提出来的
en: In the end the outcome is that the rich gain ever greater power; such logic, which never passes through the head above, could only have been put forward by a ladybird.

text: 男性总觉得他是消费者才会如此，天天让他接客十个活不过25岁，你试试他炸不炸
en: Men always think this way only because they see themselves as consumers; make them receive ten clients a day and they would not live past twenty-five — try it and see whether they would blow up.

text: 你以为的卖淫合法化：理直气壮对民警说，爷们就是来嫖的！
en: The prostitution legalisation you imagine: boldly telling the police officer, 'I'm a real man here to get laid!'

text: 通知啊！
en: Notify away!

text: 现在就通知单位！
en: Notify my work unit right now!

text: 实际上的卖淫合法化：
en: The actual prostitution legalisation:

text: 1.《关于加强“性服务”预售监管的通知》。
en: 1. 'Notice on Strengthening the Supervision of Pre-sales of "Sexual Services".'

text: 2.“如何看待老光棍掏空半辈子积蓄定制个性化性服务项目烂尾，嫖娼嫖到烂尾批”。
en: 2. 'How to view an old bachelor who emptied half a lifetime of savings to custom-order a personalised sexual-service project that was left unfinished, sleeping with a woman only to end up with an abandoned one.'

text: 3.别打了！
en: 3. Stop hitting me!

text: 别打了！
en: Stop hitting me!

text: 希尔薇我不要了！
en: Sylvie, I don't want her any more!

text: 预售款我也不要了！
en: I don't want the pre-sale deposit either!

text: 4.“如何看待两名光棍因向社会募集资金解决烂尾批项目而涉嫌非法集资被刑拘”。
en: 4. 'How to view two bachelors who were criminally detained on suspicion of illegal fundraising after raising money from society to resolve the unfinished-project matter.'

text: 5.到底发生了什么，让一个人从“眼里有淫光”到“不再闪烁”？
en: 5. What on earth happened, to take a person from 'lustful glints in the eyes' to 'no longer flickering'?

text: 唉，合法化…
en: Ah, legalisation…

text: 那些扫黄派的逻辑，是混乱的。
en: The logic of those in the anti-vice camp is muddled.

text: 一方面说卖淫嫖娼合法化会导致警察难以打击逼良为娼。
en: On the one hand they say legalising prostitution would make it hard for the police to crack down on forcing decent women into prostitution.

text: 另一方面说卖淫嫖娼合法化会造成女性普遍贪慕虚荣去卖淫而不愿意在其他岗位，因为卖淫来钱快。
en: On the other hand they say legalising prostitution would cause women generally to crave vanity and turn to prostitution rather than take other jobs, because prostitution earns money quickly.

text: 可见中国大陆的学校真的应该普及形式逻辑学。
en: This shows that schools in mainland China really ought to popularise formal logic.

text: 没法反驳。
en: Impossible to refute.

text: 因为认为“卖淫违反道德伦理”（或者说道德伦理本身）不过是人类认知在某个时间段内的产物而已，并没有什么客观规律支撑它成为一条不变的真理或规律。
en: Because the belief that 'prostitution violates moral ethics' (or moral ethics itself) is merely a product of human cognition within a certain span of time, and is not underpinned by any objective law that would make it an immutable truth or rule.

text: 从收益上讲
en: In terms of benefit

text: 卖淫不会给人们整体带来带来多大的生活提升（这种看起来入行门槛低的行业市场化以后反而只有头部能赚钱，类似直播），
en: Prostitution would not bring much improvement to people's overall living standards (an industry that seems to have low barriers to entry in fact only lets those at the top make money once it is marketised, much like live-streaming),

text: 禁止卖淫也不会带来多大的灾难（最差不会差过当年禁酒令吧）。
en: nor would banning prostitution bring much catastrophe (at worst it cannot be worse than the prohibition on alcohol back in the day).

text: 所以现在多数地方禁止卖淫完全是认知层面的原因，而如上所述认知没有对错，只是目前存在而已。
en: Therefore, the reason most places currently ban prostitution is entirely a matter of cognition, and as stated above cognition has no right or wrong — it merely exists at present.

text: 别人认知和他不在一个时代，自然没话讲
en: If another's cognition is not of the same era as his, naturally there is nothing to discuss.

text: 补丁一；
en: Patch one;

text: 和性别没关系，男女都能卖
en: It has nothing to do with gender; both men and women can sell.

text: 补丁二：
en: Patch two:

text: 有人说我支持肯定我要去piao，我还真不去，愿意有二：
en: Some say that if I support it I must want to go 'piao'; well, I genuinely would not, and I have two reasons:

text: 不卫生，而这恰恰是禁止导致的
en: It is unhygienic, and that is precisely caused by the ban.

text: 我是i人，我社恐
en: I am an introvert; I have social anxiety.

text: 我国的梅毒发病率是卖淫合法的日本的5倍以上（注意不是病例数），病例数超过60倍，显著推动了我国传染病学的研究👍
en: My country's syphilis incidence rate is more than five times that of Japan, where prostitution is legal (note: not the number of cases); the number of cases is over sixty times, which has significantly advanced research into infectious diseases in our country 👍

text: 我国有着庞大的、地下的、黑色的非法卖淫网络，并且在连续多年的打击下依然屡禁不止，甚至随着经济下行还有进一步扩大的趋势。
en: Our country has a vast, underground, black-market illegal prostitution network, which, despite years of continuous crackdowns, still persists and even shows a tendency to expand further amid the economic downturn.

text: 如果人可以被物化，那么器官买卖，人口买卖都应该合法。
en: If human beings can be treated as objects, then the buying and selling of organs and of people should both be legal.

text: 所以，我反对卖淫合法化。
en: Therefore, I oppose the legalisation of prostitution.

text: 没法反驳，因为实际广义上的卖淫早就是普遍化合法化了。
en: Impossible to refute, because in actual fact prostitution in the broad sense has long been widely legalised.

text: 普通人花几十万彩礼加房子车子买个长期单独为你服务的性服务者，有权有钱的花钱包养二奶乃至n奶，这些都是被社会接受起码是默认的。
en: Ordinary people spend hundreds of thousands in bride price plus a house and a car to buy a sex worker who serves them exclusively over the long term; the powerful and the wealthy keep a mistress, or even n mistresses, with money — all of this is accepted by society, or at the very least tacitly tolerated.

text: 虽然这些看起来不是传统意义上的卖淫，可仔细琢磨下，这些和卖淫有什么实质上的不同吗，无非只是长期工和小时工的区别，现在所谓的卖淫非法只是小时工非法，长期工却是合法的，这点还挺搞笑的
en: Although these do not look like prostitution in the traditional sense, if you think carefully, what is the substantive difference between these and prostitution? It is merely the difference between a full-time worker and an hourly worker. The so-called illegality of prostitution today is only the illegality of the hourly worker, while the full-time worker is legal — which is rather laughable.

text: 我在b站看过一个纪录片，片名忘了，其中一段是讲述某地区，那里是许多运货的卡车司机途中的休息地，那里有伎女，受采访的伎女说，她们服务一次的价格是300肯尼亚先令，换算人民币就是15元，她们会向卡车司机推销自己，以换取金钱。
en: I once watched a documentary on Bilibili; I have forgotten its title, but one segment was about a certain region that serves as a rest stop for many freight lorry drivers, where there were prostitutes. The prostitute who was interviewed said that the price for one session was 300 Kenyan shillings, about 15 yuan, and they would tout themselves to the lorry drivers in exchange for money.

text: 而这些钱用来养育她们和丈夫的孩子，那接受采访的伎女并不能算得上漂亮，只是普通，甚至相比多数人来说体型会更健硕一些，而多数片中的伎女就是这种普通的模样。
en: And this money was used to raise their children with their husbands. The interviewed prostitute could not be called beautiful — just ordinary, even rather more robust in build than most people, and most of the prostitutes in the film looked this ordinary way.

text: 她们有时候一晚上赚不到什么钱，却没有别的营生，因为那里的上层者没有给她们别的路走，没有义务教育做基础的培养，没有职业技术的学习，好像除了皮肉再没有其他可以保证生存的方式。
en: Sometimes they earn little in a whole night, yet have no other livelihood, because the upper class there has given them no other path — no compulsory education as a foundation, no vocational training — as if, apart from their bodies, there were no other means to guarantee survival.

text: 富有者不会做伎女，压迫者不会做伎女，做伎女的只有没有其他路可走的穷苦人，而如今有些人听信了“你是中产”的话语，以为自己也是生产资料的拥有者了，可以做压迫其他人的人上人了，就不把别人的尊严和自我价值当回事了。
en: The wealthy will not become prostitutes, nor will the oppressors; those who become prostitutes are only the poor who have no other road to take. Yet nowadays some people, believing the talk that 'you are middle class', think they too have become owners of the means of production and can be the superior beings who oppress others, and so they stop treating others' dignity and self-worth as mattering at all.

text: 而事实是合法之下每个普通人都是被剥削压迫的对象。
en: The truth is that under legality every ordinary person is an object of exploitation and oppression.

text: 中国古代的伎是不止女性的，“象姑馆”“娈童”“契兄弟”…
en: In ancient China, the ji were not only female — 'xianggu houses', 'luantong', 'qixiongdi'…

text: 清秀、漂亮的男性、健壮的男性，合法之后都是一些人名单上的玩具罢了。
en: Delicate, handsome men, robust men — once legalised, they are all but toys on some people's lists.

text: 就算非法的如今，莫非娱乐圈的男明星们少过“双插头”“导演曾经骚扰过他”“他们夫妻都是被某金主包养的”的戏谑绯闻？
en: Even now, when it is illegal, do the male celebrities in the entertainment industry have any fewer mocking rumours of 'double-headed plug', 'the director once harassed him', 'both husband and wife are kept by some sugar daddy'?

text: 我们已经有真正帮助穷苦人有尊严地活的方法，扶贫的项目有教授养殖技术、给予幼苗和种子、换新屋、关心生活情况的，没有教他们怎么跪着给别人舔别人的脚趾的。
en: We already have methods that truly help the poor live with dignity; poverty-alleviation projects teach farming techniques, give out seedlings and seeds, build new houses and care about living conditions — they do not teach people how to kneel and lick others' toes.

text: 如果有人已经将消费伦理观内化，认为劳动异化理所当然，觉得一切都能用金钱衡量，人的尊严与价值无关紧要，那就坦坦荡荡做这样的人，别把自己包装得多么光明正大、理性客观。
en: If someone has already internalised a consumerist ethic, takes the alienation of labour for granted, feels that everything can be measured in money and that human dignity and worth are of no consequence, then be such a person openly and unashamedly — do not package yourself as so just, rational and objective.

text: 不反驳，并鼓励持该观点的人及其家人都热情的投入到该行业中发光发热。
en: No refutation; instead, encourage those who hold this view and their families to enthusiastically throw themselves into the industry and shine.
